scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A father speaks to his attentive son in a sunlit stone courtyard, while the boy holds a small wooden treasure box close to his chest.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 7:1: the son treasures his father’s words and commands within him.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an older man offers a blank rolled scroll to a young man who holds another scroll against his chest and raises a hand near his eye. Grapevines, flowers, and a fountain surround them, with a village and hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures instruction cherished and guarded like the eye, with the flourishing garden suggesting life in Proverbs 7:2.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young person in a sunlit stone courtyard loops a dark cord around raised fingers, with a blank heart-shaped tablet against the chest and a stylus on the table nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 7:3, suggesting the binding of instruction on the fingers and its place on the tablet of the heart.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man sits between two women who greet him warmly in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath an olive tree; clay vessels, woven textiles, flowers, and distant hills surround them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene personifies wisdom and understanding as close family, reflecting the verse’s invitation to call wisdom a sister and understanding a near relative.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone town, a smiling woman gestures from a doorway while a young man looks back at her and an older man rests a guiding hand on his shoulder, pointing along the street.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene relating Proverbs 7:5's warning about flattering words to the protection offered by wisdom.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A person in a red robe and cream head covering looks through a wooden window lattice from a warmly furnished house toward a sunlit street.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the speaker looking through the lattice at the window of their house in Proverbs 7:6.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older man watches through a lattice window as four young men gather in a sunlit stone street; one looks upward uncertainly with a hand behind his head.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the observer discerning a young man lacking understanding among the youths in Proverbs 7:7.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man in a pale tunic and sandals walks along a sunlit stone street beside the corner of a house, looking toward its wooden door and steps beneath flowering vines.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 7:8, showing a young man passing near her corner on the way toward her house.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young man walks down a stone street in an ancient town, seen from behind, as an orange horizon fades beneath a deep blue sky; lamps glow among shadowed stone buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene evoking the twilight, evening, night and darkness of Proverbs 7:9.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed woman in red and purple, wearing gold jewelry, approaches a young man on a lamplit stone street at twilight. She looks at him with a knowing smile while he turns toward her.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 7:10, in which a woman meets him in the attire of a harlot and is crafty of heart.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in flowing red and cream clothing strides from an open stone house, raising one hand and calling toward a busy sunlit street; her sandaled feet are visible.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 7:11, depicting the loud, rebellious woman whose feet do not stay at home.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in layered robes watches from behind the corner of a stone building toward people in a sunlit town square, with market awnings and buildings beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 7:12, showing the woman lurking outside at a corner by the open square.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a lantern-lit stone street at dusk, a woman in a red robe grasps a startled man by the arm and kisses his cheek, raising her other hand in a gesture.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Proverbs 7:13, where the woman catches and kisses him, then speaks with an impudent face.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a stone courtyard at sunset, a woman gestures toward a table of roasted meat, flatbread and a clay pitcher while a young man listens.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the speaker describing her peace offerings and vows paid that day in Proverbs 7:14.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a red robe and light head covering touches a man's arm and looks up at him as he turns toward her on a lamplit stone street at twilight.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the woman saying she came out to meet the man, sought his face, and found him in Proverbs 7:15.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman in a richly patterned red robe spreads pale linen over a bed layered with colorful woven coverings in a lamplit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the bed spread with tapestry and colored Egyptian linen in Proverbs 7:16.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A clothed woman sprinkles perfume from a small vessel over a richly covered bed in a warm, lamp-lit room. A tray beside the bed holds resin, pale wood pieces, and cinnamon sticks.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the bed perfumed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon in Proverbs 7:17.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a lamplit ancient home, a woman in a red robe holds a man's hand and gestures toward a cushioned room; stars and the first light of dawn appear beyond the open window.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the woman's invitation to delight in love until morning in Proverbs 7:18.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler carrying a bag and walking staff heads away from a stone house along a winding road through sunlit hills toward a distant village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene illustrating Proverbs 7:19, where the husband is away from home on a long journey.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A traveler in a cream robe and rust-colored shawl walks along a sunlit path carrying a tied pouch, with a stone house behind him and a village among distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by Proverbs 7:20, in which a man takes a bag of money and is expected home on the appointed day.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At dusk on a stone street, a woman in a burgundy robe gestures and speaks to a man who turns toward her beside a warmly lit doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Proverbs 7:21, where her enticing, flattering speech persuades him to yield.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At dusk, a young man follows a woman toward a dark doorway on a lamplit stone street, while an ox approaches a wooden livestock gate nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for Proverbs 7:22, showing the man following her and the verse's comparison to an ox going to slaughter.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A distressed young man in ancient clothing sits among rocks with an arrow lodged in his side, while a small bird approaches a baited loop snare beneath a tree. A sunlit village and hills lie beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene bringing together Proverbs 7:23’s arrow and its comparison to a bird approaching a snare, unaware that its life is at stake.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A bearded elder gestures as he speaks to four attentive young men seated around him in a sunlit stone courtyard beneath leafy vines.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the call in Proverbs 7:24 to listen and pay attention to the speaker’s words.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A young traveler with one hand over his heart walks along a sunlit path, looking back toward a woman beckoning from a doorway beside a shadowed, thorny side path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting the warning in Proverbs 7:25 against turning one's heart toward her ways and straying into her paths.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A richly dressed woman stands in a lit stone doorway above a hillside road where several muscular men lie fallen beside shields, with a walled city and sunset in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects Proverbs 7:26, which warns that she has cast down many wounded and that strong men are among those slain by her.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A warmly lit stone house at sunset stands beside stone steps descending into dark, arched burial chambers containing stone tombs.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the verse’s warning that her house is a way to Sheol, descending to the chambers of death.
